# Bigml

BigML is a comprehensive machine learning platform that simplifies the creation and deployment of predictive models through an intuitive web interface and a REST API.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bigml/.

## Actions

- **Create External Connector**: Create a new external connector for data sources.
- **Create Project**: Create a new project.
- **Delete Project**: Delete an existing project.
- **Get External Connector**: Retrieve details of an external connector.
- **Get Project**: Retrieve details of a project by id.
- **List Correlations**: List correlation resources.
